title: Logarithmic query lower bound for non-adaptive message reconstruction of arbitrary binary codes
author: Sourav Chakraborty, Eldar Fischer, and Arie Matsliah
work: Query Complexity Lower Bounds for Reconstruction of Codes
source_version: Theory of Computing volume 10 article 19 (2014), official complete journal PDF acquired 2026-09-30; canonical DOI 10.4086/toc.2014.v010a019 verified against official landing and printed PDF header
difficulty_reason: After standard concentration and counting prerequisites, the selected lower bound still requires the authored influential/non-influential partition and received-word distribution tailored to simultaneous reconstruction, followed by a bounded-increment Doob martingale obstruction. The deferred typical-seed claim is proved by the explicit shared-randomness compression/decoder construction at617–695, rather than assumed as background. These new mechanisms apply to arbitrary code length and encoding, constituting one H2 lower-bound task beyond standard coding-theory qualification exercises.
